title: Scale the worker and index shipments by status
author: sade.m
description:
Carrier polling has been falling behind since the holiday volume started.

- Worker: 2 → 4 replicas, concurrency 4 → 8 per replica, and the carrier request timeout drops from 30s to 10s so one slow carrier can't hold a slot for half a minute.
- New index on `shipments (status, created_at desc)`, created concurrently, for the status queries.

No application code changes.
ask: Could the worker run out of database connections after this change?
